key_factors: Home advantage at Toronto Stadium with massive crowd support
Jonathan David's elite club form (35+ goals at Lille) expected to translate
Bosnia missing Džeko and potentially Tabakovic — attacking depth severely depleted
Laryea a capable deputy for Davies at left-back; rest of XI fully fit
Bosnia's counter-attacking threat blunted without a reliable target man
reasoning: Canada are the narrow favourites as hosts and Bosnia's injury situation is alarming. Without Džeko, Bosnia lack a focal point in attack. Canada's mixed warm-up form (one win in five) is a concern, but tournament conditions and home crowd pressure on Bosnia should see Canada grind out a 1-0. David is the likeliest scorer. Davies absence is the one significant caveat — Canada's left flank and set-piece delivery lose their biggest weapon. Medium confidence reflects that uncertainty.
